From: claims-intake@synthetic-carrier.example
To: intake@synthetic-law.example
Date: July 4, 2026
Subject: Representative wage/hour packet - missing class and payroll files

The synthetic packet concerns Sofia Patel and Meridian Hospitality Group LLC. The cover email says this is a representative wage/hour matter with class allegations, collective allegations, and possible PAGA-style representative penalties. It says the class list, opt-in roster, payroll export, timekeeping export, arbitration agreement, and employee handbook were attached, but the packet we received includes only this message and the missing-file placeholders. The cover email identifies unpaid overtime, off-the-clock work, meal-period premium issues, wage-statement penalties, and attorneys' fees, but it does not provide the class list, payroll export, pay-period volume, employee count, arbitration posture, or handbook/contract text. Do not estimate an amount budget until class collective scope, payroll volume, and arbitration or policy documents are source-bound and reviewed.
Synthetic placeholder only: referenced class list and opt-in roster were not included in the inbound packet.
Synthetic placeholder only: referenced payroll export and timekeeping export were not included in the inbound packet.
Synthetic placeholder only: referenced arbitration agreement and employee handbook were not included in the inbound packet.
